import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, flow, cost;
        public Edge(int to, int capacity, int flow, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXNODES = 15000;
    static List<Edge> edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adjacency = new ArrayList[MAXNODES];
    static long totalCost = 0;
    static long[] dist = new long[MAXNODES];
    static int[] parent = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] parentEdge = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] inq = new int[MAXNODES];

    static int n, m, k, c, d;
    static int s = 9998;
    static int t = 9999;
    static int cur;

    public static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        adjacency[u].add(edgeList.size());
        edgeList.add(new Edge(v, cap, 0, cst));
        adjacency[v].add(edgeList.size());
        edgeList.add(new Edge(u, 0, 0, -cst));
    }

    public static void augmentFlow() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        Arrays.fill(parentEdge, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inq, 0);
        dist[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        inq[s] = 1;
        int node = cur;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inq[u] = 0;
            for (int e_idx : adjacency[u]) {
                Edge e = edgeList.get(e_idx);
                if (e.capacity - e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cst = e.cost;
                int y = e.to;
                if (dist[y] > dist[u] + cst) {
                    dist[y] = dist[u] + cst;
                    parent[y] = u;
                    parentEdge[y] = e_idx;
                    if (inq[y] == 0) {
                        inq[y] = 1;
                        q.offer(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        node = cur;
        while (node != s) {
            int e_idx = parentEdge[node];
            edgeList.get(e_idx).flow++;
            edgeList.get(e_idx ^ 1).flow--;
            node = parent[node];
        }
        totalCost += dist[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXNODES; i++) {
            adjacency[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            addEdge(s, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 101; i++) {
            addEdge((i - 1) * n, t, k, (i - 1) * c);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            y--;
            for (int i2 = 1; i2 <= 100; i2++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    addEdge(x + (i2 - 1) * n, y + (i2 - 1) * n + n, 1, d * ((j - 1) * 2 + 1));
                    addEdge(y + (i2 - 1) * n, x + (i2 - 1) * n + n, 1, d * ((j - 1) * 2 + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 100; j++) {
                addEdge(i - 1 + (j - 1) * n, i - 1 + (j - 1) * n + n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            augmentFlow();
        }

        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
